policy.landing_to_reader: Every current hosted reader has a visible inbound link from its localized course card or course gateway.
policy.reader_to_landing: Every hosted HTML document has visible top and bottom links back to the localized course card.
policy.reader_subpage_to_contents: Every non-root hosted reader document has a visible link to its reader contents page.
policy.reader_forward_closure: For every multi-page reader, the declared entry and contents graph reaches every registered HTML document; each non-entry document returns directly to a declared contents document.
policy.gateway_internal_closure: Every multi-page gateway declares its complete per-document contents mapping; its entry reaches every registered HTML document and every non-entry document returns directly to a declared contents or entry document.
policy.source_and_mirror: A program-hosted mirror never replaces the prominent authoritative-original link.
policy.future_locales: New language interfaces use their own stable language root and the same course IDs; reader bodies remain below locale-scoped course routes where practical.
policy.shared_surface_returns: Every hosted reader, gateway, course surface, and navigable generic page visibly returns to every applicable localized course card and every localized program root.
policy.source_integrity: Navigation is a deterministic removable hosting shell. Source and hosted hashes are recorded separately; mathematical bodies are not rewritten.
policy.universal_access_slots: Every course in every registered language interface reserves separately typed program-hosted and authoritative-original actions. Hosted availability is asserted only after source, rights, dependency, navigation, deterministic-build, and public-byte gates pass.
policy.course_surfaces: Every course-scoped learner, educator, terminology, and backend HTML surface returns to every course card it serves.
policy.complete_html_closure: Every HTML document under docs is explicitly classified; build templates that remain historically public are labeled rather than silently omitted.
policy.overlay_cardinality: Every central transformed document has exactly one top and one bottom navigation landmark; each repeats the complete applicable relation set.
policy.absolute_relation_targets: Every central course anchor, program root, and authoritative-original target in the overlay is absolute HTTPS; only lineage-local contents links remain relative.
policy.hosted_copy_to_original: Every course-scoped central HTML surface links every authoritative original bound to each course it serves.
policy.embedded_excerpt_navigation: Typed PreTeXt excerpt routes are reached through their native data-knowl controls. Standalone excerpts retain return navigation; the reader removes that shell from the embedded clone only.

reciprocal_hubs.purpose: Language chooser for the Open Logic component used by C80; the central program retains its own course-scoped C80 return route.
